scope: FlowBench steady 3D corrected64 only; not own transient/free-surface CFD
selection: minimum completed geometry-macro validation S, earlier attempt on exact tie; no partial or failed winner
checkpoint_selection: minimum geometry-macro validation S across20epochs, earlier epoch on tie
normalization: fixed verified sorted train-only moments; identical for all methods
duplicate_search_configuration: allowed and fully charged, no search-time deduplication
duplicate_final_configuration: deduplicate only exact canonical parameters with same final seed/manifest; retain all95references
failure_policy: count attempt/time; incomplete trial not selectable; no automatic restart or free extra attempt
test_policy: not opened by preparation/search/final training; one separately gated evaluation after all choices/checkpoints locked

latency.primary: gpu_pipeline synchronized wall p99 in each round
latency.hardware: same NVIDIA H200 for all final models

statistics.primary_contrasts: each of4LLM minusTPE on heldout geometry-macro S, negative favors LLM; all declared; no best-family selection on test
statistics.resampling: crossed paired percentile bootstrap: independently resample geometry G, search-repeat3, final-seed5 axes with replacement; same indices for every method and all4contrasts in each replicate; keep all10Re within each geometry and average Re before resampling; average all resampled Gx3x5 cells
statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni nominal familywise95percent: four two-sided98.75percent percentile intervals; quantiles0.00625,0.99375 using numpy quantile method=linear; primary benefit only if adjusted upper bound<0; no pilot p-values
statistics.limitations: Approximate bootstrap coverage, not exact finite-sample95percent guarantee; only3search repeats limits inference; geometry-familyOOD not established; also report every paired repeat effect and seed/geometry dispersion
statistics.secondary: manual/random comparisons, Eu/Ep/divergence, costs, failures and raw-JSON validity descriptive; no confirmatory significance claims from unadjusted secondary comparisons

completion_policy: incomplete balanced final phase must be reported as incomplete, not selectively omit expensive/poor methods
